name: Meridian Logistics
blurb: Same-day ACH origination took two days out of a payroll run for 640 drivers.
overview: Meridian ran payroll through a processor that took three business days to settle, which meant funding on Tuesday for a Friday pay date. Moving origination onto Rockfield same-day ACH, with dual approval held by their controller and CFO, brought funding to the day before and removed the float they were carrying purely to cover the gap.

name: Harrow Street Residences
blurb: A construction facility drawn against surveyed progress rather than a fixed calendar.
overview: Eighty-four units on a constrained site, financed on a facility that released against surveyed progress rather than a fixed schedule. The developer kept a named underwriter through the whole build, which mattered twice when the programme moved.

name: Field & Vine Grocers
blurb: Next-business-day settlement across nine stores, reconciled against the operating account automatically.
overview: Card settlement arriving on different days across nine stores made reconciliation a weekly argument. Settlement now lands next business day into one operating account with store-level references on every deposit, and the bookkeeper has read-only access that cannot move money.

name: The Ellis household
blurb: Round-ups and an automatic sweep the day after payday, with nothing to remember.
overview: Two salaries landing on different days and a savings habit that kept losing to the month. A sweep the day after each payday and round-ups on card spending did what a budgeting app had not, because neither of them required a decision.
